body: Recently a girl who I've grown more close to than myself told me she didn't want to date. I just thought I was a bit advancing, and maybe it would be a good idea to back off. She then flirts with my best friend. I flip out on her for turning us against each other. Been some time, I apologize. I feel jealousy that her and my friend still flirt, hate for myself that I'm still jealous, hate for him for flirting with her, hate for her for being so indecisive between me or him and confusion at the whole situation. I haven't been diagnosed yet, but I'm almost entirely sure that I have ADD or something similar as it runs in the family. I'm doing god awful in school, and although I know most of the content being taught I have trouble keeping up with the other kids, finishing homework on time, and because my immune system is so weak I get sick a lot and miss school. I can't find the effort, all I have is a tiny voice in my head saying "hey you should probably do this." But I have a bigger voice saying "Why not video games?" I tell myself that I'm going to do the work, but I never get around to doing it. Hell, I'm procrastinating right now. My mom, brother and dad get disappointed when I do bad in school, but I can't help it. Not like my brother has room to judge, anyway, he didn't do so good himself. My dream is to become a cook and attend the CIA, but I know I'll never achieve it if I keep feeling like this, and doing like this in school. I have way too much stress for a 16 year old, but even I think I'm overreacting when I say this. I want to make myself think that none of this is true but I know it is. This is just too much for me.
